caption: The drawing depicts a single hat rendered in fine, dark lines on a light beige background. The hat has a rounded crown and a wide, curved brim. Around the base of the crown, a wide, textured band or ribbon with a checkered or lace-like pattern encircles the hat, and darker shading accentuates this feature. The brim and the lower edge of the hat are adorned with multiple feather-like decorations that cascade downwards, drawn with delicate, wavy lines. The composition centers the hat, with its full form and ornamentation clearly visible, and no other objects or background elements are present.
